description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyNotAllowedException' within the Eclipse Ditto framework, used to signal an error condition where a Thing cannot be modified due to the presence of a Policy. The class includes static factory methods, a builder pattern for constructing instances, and references multiple Ditto-specific classes and interfaces.
